s1.syndrome_frame: chronic swelling and discomfort in the oral cavity with fluctuating pain intensity and sensation of heaviness
salient_findings: slowly growing swelling in the right upper vestibule
firm, mildly tender diffuse swelling of the adjacent vestibular mucosa
mild periapical radiolucency at the affected root apices
key_facts: 45-year-old woman
2-month history of symptoms
swelling and discomfort in the right upper vestibule
fluctuations in pain intensity
sensation of heaviness in the area
teeth #15 and #16 are grossly carious
no tenderness on percussion of the involved teeth
mild periapical radiolucency on panoramic radiography
preoperative blood tests are within normal limits
gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue obtained on curettage

shortlist.label: Periapical granuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue obtained on curettage and mild periapical radiolucency on panoramic radiography

shortlist.label: Periapical cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic swelling and discomfort in the oral cavity with fluctuating pain intensity and sensation of heaviness, and mild periapical radiolucency on panoramic radiography

shortlist.label: Radicular cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Grossly carious teeth and mild periapical radiolucency on panoramic radiography

shortlist.label: Mucocele
shortlist.why_kept: Gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue obtained on curettage and swelling in the oral cavity

shortlist.label: Pyogenic granuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Swelling and discomfort in the oral cavity with fluctuating pain intensity and sensation of heaviness

raw.rationale: The presence of a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue on curettage, along with a mild periapical radiolucency and the absence of tenderness on percussion, supports the diagnosis of a periapical granuloma, which is a collection of granulation tissue in response to a pulpally infected tooth.

rejected.label: Periapical cyst
rejected.why: Periapical cysts typically present with a well-defined radiolucency and may have a more fluctuant swelling, which is not described in this case.

rejected.label: Radicular cyst
rejected.why: Radicular cysts are a type of periapical cyst and would have similar characteristics, which do not match this case.

rejected.label: Mucocele
rejected.why: Mucoceles typically present as a fluctuant, bluish swelling, often in the lower lip or cheek, which does not match the description of this case.

rejected.label: Pyogenic granuloma
rejected.why: Pyogenic granulomas are typically found on the gingiva and are associated with local irritation, which is not the primary presentation in this case.
